name: infimount-agent-tasks
description: Use Infimount Agent Tasks to work on selected storage files inside a scoped MCP workspace and return outputs for explicit review.

interface.shortDescription: Work on scoped storage files and return reviewable outputs
interface.longDescription: Infimount Agent Tasks prepares selected storage files into a local, path-scoped Agent Workspace. Codex works only through the existing Infimount MCP boundary, writes deliverables under outputs/, and leaves publication to the Infimount desktop user after review.
defaultPrompt: Work on the prepared Infimount Agent Task in this workspace.
Read TASK.md and create the requested files under outputs/.
